about.title: Turning Ideas into Interactive Digital Products
about.description:
I'm Mohamed El Aouri, a creative Full-Stack Web Developer and content creator. I specialize in crafting performant and elegant applications using modern technologies like React, Node.js, MongoDB, and Next.js.

My work blends frontend precision with backend logic — often enhanced by animations via Framer Motion and 3D visuals using Three.js. I build real-world projects, contribute to open source, and maintain a full JavaScript course on GitHub.

Currently pursuing a CS degree 🎓, I’ve already created over 50+ JavaScript projects, written technical blog posts, and designed apps from the ground up. I'm actively looking for a company where I can grow, collaborate, and make an impact.

✍️ Fun fact: I love writing about advanced JS topics like the event loop, eval, and execution contexts — and I often teach them through interactive code examples.
